items.item_text: Current BLS through American Heart Association
Bachelors of Science in Health Management or Business Administration
One (1) year of supervisor or lead experience
Three (3) years experience as a technologist
One (1) year experience in an outpatient environment
Billing and coding experience and understanding of radiology exams and procedures.

As our Imaging Services Supervisor, you will thoughtfully oversee all specialized, administrative, and regulatory operations, ensuring seamless and patient-centered service delivery. Every day you will champion your team, proactively advocating for their needs, ideas, and concerns directly to leadership. Leveraging your exceptional communication skills, you will adeptly navigate challenging conversations and serve as a dedicated educator, utilizing every interaction to enhance understanding of patient, staff, and organizational needs. To be successful in this role, you will demonstrate both competence and confidence, effectively managing your team through clear communication, robust performance management, strategic hiring, and comprehensive training initiatives.
Other Satisfactory completion of a formal AMA school of Radiologic Technology or equivalent to an AMA Technologic program

One of the following: Registered Technologist Radiography ARRT, Registered Technologist Magnetic Resonance Imaging, Medical Radiographer: CA, Registered Diagnostic Medical Sonographer, Registered Technologist Cardio Interventional Radiography, Registered Technologist Nuclear Medicine Technology, Registered Technologist Mammography
Expertise in use of digital imaging applications such as PACS, RIS, EMR and other technical applications to support imaging modalities.
Excellent interpersonal, organizational and customer service skills are essential.
Demonstrated knowledge of anatomy and physiology for imaging, proper operation of and care of radiology diagnostic equipment, and radiation safety is required.
